text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While at the mall on my day off, I spot
Taiki
Shuttle with some friends at a pet
shop.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Are you okay, Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
How could I possibly be okay with this
bundle of
cuteness in front of me?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I can't hold back any longer! Time to
give it a real
good cuddle!

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof! Grr!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Eek! B-but why?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Sniffle... You gotta help me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try to comfort Taiki as she explains the
situation
through her tears.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka got to hug that little puppy, but
it won't
even let me touch its paw...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sigh... It's breakin' my poor heart... I wish I was Suzuka right now.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: U-um... Well... Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind giving us some
suggestions on
how to get the puppy to
warm up to Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Tell me what to do, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Makes sense! I bet the little fella can
smell my
fear! Okay—time to give it
another whirl!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Listen up, pup! Look me in the eye!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm the sheriff 'round these parts, so
what I say
goes! The only laws here are
the laws of the Wild
West!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So... you better let me hug you!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I think that might have been a bit
much...

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, here comes the puppy! It must be
lookin' for
a hug!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No way...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The puppy has taken a liking to Taiki
Shuttle.
Looks like she managed to show
it who's boss.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Good idea. Maybe the puppy was just
nervous
because Taiki was nervous...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see! Okay—I'll get things right this
time
around!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Breathe in... and out...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Breathe in... and out...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, Taiki? I think that's enough
relaxing...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, my bad! Thanks for the
heads-up,
Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki attempts to hug the puppy again...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh my lucky stars...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm glad things worked out for
you.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you just the cutest little thing?
Lemme get
another feel of that fluffy fur
of yours!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looks like playtime with the puppy is
really
helping Taiki Shuttle recover.
